title: FIRST STEP
description: Quickly extend your lead arm (jab), slightly rotating your fist at the end of the motion. Keep your other hand protecting your face.

title: SECOND STEP
description: Start the cross by rotating the heel of your back leg outward. Follow through with your hip and torso rotation to generate power.

title: THIRD STEP
description: Extend your rear arm in a straight line, keeping your shoulder high to protect your chin. Rotate your fist at the moment of impact.

title: FOURTH STEP
description: Retract your arm immediately along the same path. Return to your initial guard with a firm stance and tight core.
